title: cn theme names
description: cn-theme.gen.json: the theme's names and text style classes, written by scripts/gen/cn-theme.ts, so cn() merges Rove's own utilities (type-caption, p-12) as it does Tailwind's.

tailwindThemeNames.description: Each Tailwind theme namespace (spacing, color…) with the names in it: --spacing-12 is 12 under spacing.

textStyleClasses.description: Each text style's class from rove-tokens' text-styles.css.
